title: Purushottam Maas - III
subtitle: Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha
description: Purushottam Maas - III — a themed treasury of teachings gathered by the Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha.

articles.title: Why Does He Steal?
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Here, Srila Guru Maharaj reveals the secret behind the nectarine pastime of Krishna as a thief, very sweetly! Actually, all the milk-women of Vraja prepares yogurt, milk, butter and everything for the service of Krishna only. But Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi do not allow Krishna to eat at any other place. So what? Krishna is bhakta-vatsala, subdued by pure devotion, He always thinks about fulfilling the desire of His devotees. So, He becomes a thief and steals yogurt, butter, etc. from the houses of gopa-gopis to give them satisfaction.

blocks.text: Gopal, small child of Yashoda Devi, so small. All the gopis and gopas, milk-men and milk-women, complain to Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi, “You should be very careful about your child.”
“Why?”
“Your son is very naughty.”
“Naughty? How? My son is very good.”

“You see, when we sleep in the night we keep a lamp lighted so that no thief can enter. But your son, Kanaiya, with other cowherd boys in the mid-night enters our house and blows it by the wind of the mouth, extinguishes the lamp and steals all the yogurt, butter, etc.”
“What is this? If He desires anything, we can give. Why should He steal?”
Then Nanda Maharaj, very much astounded and asks, “Kanaiya! Have You done this?”
“No father.”
What do you say, Pappa? Daddy?
“I have not done this. They are speaking lies.”
Mother Yashoda, “Kanaiya! You had been visiting the houses of the milk-men and milk-women to steal?”
“No, they are speaking lies, they are telling lie.”

Actually Krishna was speaking truth because all the milk-women are preparing everything for the service of Krishna, yogurt, sweets, etc., butter everything. But when they approached Nanda Maharaj and Yashoda Devi, “We want to feed your child, please send Him.”
“No! I have got ten thousand cows. I am Nanda Maharaj, why will my son go to other houses to eat? No.” Yashoda Mata also refused.

Krishna is bhakta-vatsala, always subdued by the pure devotion of the devotee; how to fulfill their desire. Krishna Himself went, “Pappa, I want to take the food prepared by such and such gopi’s house. Can I go?”
“Oh, You have become greedy. You have got everything here. I cannot allow You to go.”
Then how to fulfill their desire?
“So, I am to become a thief to fulfill their desire. They are telling lie. They have prepared everything for Me. And I have gone there as a thief to fulfill their desire.”

articles.title: Tat-te Anukampam Su-samiksamana
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Srila Guru Maharaj explains the inner meaning of the shloka 'tat te 'nukampāṁ su-samīkṣamāṇo' from the prayers of Brahma to Sri Krishna. Votaries, who want to progress in spiritual life should give special emphasis on the subject spoken here. Gurumaharaj speaks on, who will get God, who will realize Supreme Lord Sri Krishna and who will get His service? He explains, "God is gracing you under all circumstances. In difficulties, at good times, bad times, whatever you are getting in this world, the Supreme Lord is gracing you. If you do not see His grace then you will not get it. When you see His grace even in distress then you will get Him. We are reaping the fruits of our own actions. Others are only instrumental, they are not the cause. If you blame others then you will not get God."

blocks.text: We cannot understand the teachings of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and His personal associates without their grace, by the process of ascension, ārohavāda; by challenging mood, with material ego, material intellect, material mental capacity! Just the opposite, they could not understand the actual meaning because they are not surrendered to them. It will descend; Dham, the transcendental realm and Supreme Lord and His personal associates all are transcendental, spiritual. They descend in this world. They are not part of this material world. We think like that. Even Brahma who has created us, all the creatures here, by his order, could not understand Krishna as Supreme Lord. It is written in Bhagavat! There Vedvyasa muni has not written that this is his pastime. We may say because we are in the preceptorial channel. We remember Brahma. So Brahma performed this as a pastime. But why did Vedvyasa Muni not say anything about this? Because we are fools. We will understand, 'Oh! Brahma actually knows everything, but he has played the pastimes of not knowing.' Then the gravity will be lost. For that reason intentionally Vedvyasa Muni did not write anything saying Brahma had made the pastimes. No. When Brahma, the creator, could not understand how we can understand by challenging mood?

It will come through the preceptorial channel, bonafide preceptorial channel. If you take shelter; if you have the aptitude to take shelter completely, unconditional surrender, immediately you will get everything. All problems will be solved. You will get peace in your mind, bliss and you will give it to others. He is equal to all.

(The Supreme Lord says,) “There is no enemy to Me.” But when we shall go by challenging mood, we shall now see whether Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is correct or not, whether Nityananda Prabhu is correct or not, whether His personal associate, Srila Saraswati Goswami is correct or not, Bhaktivinoda Thakur is correct or not, like that, if we have that sort of ego, we shall go to hell. Nothing will come, everything will be destroyed. He will be out and out atheist, with a challenging mood if he goes. But if he submits,

as Krishna says in the Gita. You do not want to believe in this. With a challenging mood then our spiritual life will be lost. Nobody can rescue us. It is coming through the preceptorial channel. Very easy and very difficult. If you take the submission, if you are simple-hearted, then very easy. If there is duplicity in your mind, crookedness and all this sort of ego, material ego then you can have no progress in spiritual life. No progress. How will Krishna appear? Krishna will not appear. He is for Himself and by Himself. He is not for anyone. If I take shelter, then He will come. If I do not take shelter, how will He come?

In Western philosophy also they say 'Absolute is for itself and by itself'. We do not say 'It God'. We say 'He God'. Absolute is for Himself and by Himself. One thing we see in Srimad Bhagavatam, Vedvyasa Muni has written. Very carefully, we have to think about this. Who will get God? Who will realize God, Supreme Lord? Sri Krishna who will get His service? In one verse,

Our Gurumaharaj used to explain this verse very nicely. I am remembering that; tat te 'nukampāṁ su-samīkṣamāṇo. If ordinarily you see, you observe, then you will not be able to understand that God is gracing you under all circumstances.

In difficulties, in good times, bad times, whatever you are getting in this world, the Supreme Lord is gracing you. If you do not see His grace then you will not get it. Īkṣamāṇo means to observe ordinarily, samīkṣamāṇo—thoroughly, even by thoroughly seeing we may commit mistakes, su-samīkṣamāṇo—nicely, minutely and thoroughly if you see in every circumstances; bad and good circumstances, He is gracing. When you see His grace even in distress then you will get Him. If you blame others then you will not get God.

Bhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam—we are reaping the fruits of our own actions. God is everywhere. Without His knowledge nothing can be done. We had many of our births, millions of births, what we did we do not know. We are reaping the fruits. Others, they are only instrumental, they are not the cause. If you think there is somebody who is hostile to me, then your going to the Supreme Lord is destroyed immediately. You will not get Him. You will find in the biography of Dhruva. Why did Chaitanya Mahaprabhu hear Dhruva, the biographies of Dhruva and Prahlad repeatedly, why? What is the reason? He appeared with the form and mode of worship of Radha-Krishna to taste His own sweetness. What is the reason for His hearing about biographies of Dhruva and Prahlad hundred times and again He wants to hear. He is teaching us, those who are conditioned souls of this world, all votaries who want actual eternal benefit, spiritual benefit, devotional benefit, for them.

Be very very careful. You should see the grace of the Supreme Lord under all circumstances and don't blame others for your distress and sufferings. If you blame, then you will not get as per Dhruva (Charitra). You have gone through Dhruva? I say I have gone through Dhruva, please speak something new, this I know. But why did Chaitanya Mahaprabhu hundred times repeatedly hear? Dhruva is a pure devotee. He is transcendental, Prahlad is also transcendental. You cannot finish by hearing. The Supreme Lord is infinite, His personal associates are also infinite. Nobody can finish by talking about them. If anybody says I have finished, as our Swami Maharaj used to say Fool No.1. He is Fool No.1. F O O L. Nobody can finish speaking about Krishna and Krishna's devotees. He is infinite. As per our degree of submission, to that extent they will appear; that is not the last, it will go on ad infinitum. That is the transcendental realm; it never becomes stale; always fresh fresh fresh. Narada Goswami always chanting the holy name and he is relishing it at every step, every step; prati-padaṁ pūrṇāmṛtāsvādanaṁ; it will never become stale; holy name, holy pastimes, forms, attributes of Sri Krishna are not stale. Like that the holy pastimes and teachings and qualifications or attributes of śuddha-bhakta are not stale.

articles.title: Lord’s Glories to be Heard With Full Attention
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: In the initial part of this harikatha, Srila Gurudev explains the first verse of the prayers of Brahma to Sri Krishna and later he elaborately speaks on how Sukadeva Goswami had continuously for seven days sung the glories of the Supreme Lord and His devotees. After hearing the glories of the Supreme Lord for seven days continuously, Parikshit Maharaj, attained the highest objective.

blocks.text: First of all I pay my innumerable prostrated humble obeisances to the Lotus feet of my most revered Gurudeva Nityaleela Pravishta Om Vishnupad Ashtottara Shata Sri Srimad Bhakti Dayita Madhava Goswami Maharaj the absolute counter-part of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna and His Grace Incarnate. I pray for His causeless mercy to bestow me strength to sing the glories of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna and His personal associates to purify my mind and to get one-pointed exclusive devotion to Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. I pay my innumerable prostrated obeisances at the Lotus feet of my most revered śikṣā Gurus and pray for their causeless mercy to give me strength to sing the glories of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna and his entourage to purify my mind and to get exclusive devotion to Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. I pay my due respects to all who are present here.

Tomorrow is the last day of the observance of Purushottam-vrata. Tomorrow observance of vrata will be finished. Now we are engaged. In spite of that, without going down to the ground floor to Sankirtan Bhavan I have to remain here to meet you to get the blessings of devotees of Great Britain, London, Holland, Slovenia etc. I have got several questions. I think it is for my own benefit. You have got a sincere desire to get the answers of the questions and you are reminding me. My position is worse than yours. You are reminding me. It is beneficial for me. I shall try to go through these questions and make myself understand and rectify. In that way I shall give you the reply.

Now observance of Purushottam-vrata is here, something I must say. Purushottam-vrata now I think we will not be able to complete the prayers of Brahma. I shall have to speak on it for another three to four days. Otherwise we will not be able to finish. There are forty verses. We have gone through up to twenty-six or twenty-eight verses. I have to understand every word. First, I have to make myself understand, otherwise listeners won't be able to understand. It is for my own benefit. Your questions are beneficial to me. I am grateful for this.

By the desire of the Supreme Lord, you have sent me such questions so that I may remove my doubts. I have got my doubts. Who is Purushottam? It is very difficult to understand. In the first verse of his prayers Brahma has said
Who is the object of worship? At first, Brahma could not understand, at least he played the pastimes of not understanding. He saw Krishna as a cowherd boy. He did not give Him any value.

After being infatuated by Krishna, he took shelter of the lotus feet of Krishna, and by the grace of Krishna then he understood that the person standing before me is not an ordinary person; He is the prime cause of all causes, He is the Supreme Lord of all lords. He is the highest reality possessing infinite opulences and is the sweetest of the sweetest, avatāri Krishna. But what are we hearing here? How can we understand? Even with descriptions we cannot understand, I cannot understand.

Naumīḍya te 'bhra-vapuṣe, the ultimate reality has got form. But not like our form which is a transformation of five elements. Krishna's spiritual, transcendental body is not like us and Krishna's all personal associates are also transcendental, spiritual. How can we understand? He is explaining, “You are the highest.” He is saying Krishna is standing with a flute inserted inside His waist, a cane and horn under the left armpit, and in the left hand a morsel of yogurt and rice mix, standing and eating. By seeing this Brahma (initially) thought He must not be a Bhagavan. Doesn't He know vedic instructions? He is holding a morsel of food on His left hand. In the Vedas, it is prohibited. You have to take food with your right hand. Brahma thought He does not know the instructions. How can he be Bhagavan?

Now after the grace of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna, everything is changed. What he is saying. You are ultimate reality. What sort of word you are using? Yes, this cowherd boy is the ultimate reality. Yogurt & rice mixture in the left hand palm, peacock feather on the head, and also ornaments in the ear made of guñjā (a small black and white seed.) Everything He wears is of the forest and His garland is also of wild flowers, He is decorated, endowed with all this. His color is blackish, like the color of a rain-borne cloud. And He wears a loincloth. God? Supreme Lord in loincloth? What is this? We think it is absurd. The loincloth is dazzling because of the yellow color. It is dazzling like lightning and the whole face is adorned with all these things. After that, seeing the lotus feet of Krishna which are very tender, very sweet, by seeing that the Gopis come to confidantes (sakhis) and they become unconscious, thinking how can Krishna move in this forest with these tender feet? We cannot imagine. All this he is narrating. Like human being we see, with cloth and bamboo flute. But how he can be the Lord of all lords? Can you understand by our own wisdom? Any enslaved jiva or conditioned soul of this world can understand it? How he can?
You will find in Krishna worship, you are to meditate. That meditation is allowed. First you have to meditate the form of Krishna. After meditating

Those who worship Krishna, how do they worship, how do they meditate? Something fictitious? This verse is from the scripture narrating all the aspects of Krishna. He has got sat-puṇḍarīka-nayanam, very beautiful lotus eyes. Like us? We have got eyes, He has got eyes. Later on, it has been stated in the prayer that difference is that, in the transcendental form all the sense organs, all body, all parts of the body have got all qualities of sense organs. By hand He can see, smell, hear. Difference is there. By feet. All sense organs have total all sense organs power. It has been mentioned there.

Now you meditate. When you worship Guru, you have to meditate on the form of Guru, position of Guru, where is Guru. You have to meditate on Panchatattva, and where Guru is sitting you have to meditate that. Otherwise you cannot perform Guru puja. This meditation mantra; is it fictitious? By fictitious ideas you cannot worship. It is not fictitious. It will be revealed in your heart. If you are sincere and if there is simple heartedness, no deceitfulness is there, then He is equal to all. If there is true devotion then all the beauty of this narration will be revealed to your heart, extremely beautiful. Extreme is also not sufficient. There is no word by which you can say. So much attractive that you can forget everything by seeing that. If you get the grace, and if Krishna appears here, if there are no eyes to see Him, you cannot see.

You have heard about Parikshit Maharaj. What did he do? Parikshit Maharaj was cursed that after seven days he would die by snakebite. After giving all the responsibilities to Janmejaya, he went to Shukartal by the side of Ganges and all the munis, great saints, and all kings came there. He submitted his prayer. I am cursed. After seven days, I will be killed by a snake bite. I am taking shelter of you. Please give me advice. What should I do? They are advising, they are yogis, gyānis, karmis etc. Different saints had different views. He was puzzled. Whose advice should I take, follow, and whose should I not? If I do not follow then those saints will be dissatisfied. My time is short. He remembered Krishna, 'I was born in a Pandava family. Pandavas are dear to You. Oh Krishna! You rescued me when I was in my mother's womb. Oh, Krishna! Please show me the path.' Then Krishna sent his own person Sukadeva Goswami, His own person, who had brahmananda but who has given up brahmānanda and started worshiping Krishna. Brahmānanda is nothing compared to Krishna premānanda.

As per the order of Krishna, he put his holy footprints there in Shukartal. All the munis came. But on the way, many people could not understand him (Sukadeva). He is only sixteen years of age, and naked. All the villagers saw him. They thought he was a mad person, a crazy person. They could not understand. They were throwing stones, dirt, etc. A learned man can understand the dignity of a learned person. An illiterate person cannot give dignity to a learned person. He has no capacity. A sadhu can understand a sadhu. Non-sadhu cannot understand. He did not say anything because he is Paramahamsa.

When he set footprints there, all the saints including Parashuram, Agastya Muni who drank the ocean, they all stood up and they saw thousands and thousands of suns appearing. But the villagers; they did not see. Parikshit Maharaj is satisfied. Whatever you will instruct, I shall act accordingly. Then he said you are not to do anything—yagya, karma, gyāna, yoga. By this you will not be able to deliver yourself from the imminent danger. I, Sukadeva Goswami had Brahmānanda when I was in my mother's womb, then I got Krishna premānanda from my Gurudeva Vedavyasa. I have got no attraction for Brahmānanda. You should hear the glories of Krishna for a week incessantly and do nothing else. No saint had the power to say anything against him. There were so many saints. They did not say anything.

Parikshit Maharaj was hearing. We are to compare with this. What sort of speaking of Sukadeva Goswami? What sort of hearing of Parikshit Maharaj? This was second session (of Bhagavatam). First session was there in Badrinarayan, third session in Naimisharanya. Everywhere was pindrop silence. No hubbub of the city. And Parikshit Maharaj was hearing without taking food, water, and rest. Can we imagine, can we do this? If we demand to get that without doing this, how can we get it? You require a bonafide Sadguru. Actually who has dedicated himself for the service of Krishna. Where Krishna's transcendental glories are descending, not going through scriptures only. Descending, powerful words, transcendental words—śabda brahma. When he was speaking he did not take rest, he did not take food along with Parikshit Maharaj. But he asked Parikshit Maharaj, “You should take rest, you should take water, food. Otherwise you would not be able to hear.” Then Parikshit Maharaj said, “I have got only seven days time. Don't bother. Do not think about me. I am alright. You are giving me nectar of harikatha, transcendental ambrosia. I am satisfied. I do not want to sleep, I shall die in seven days. I do not want to take water or food. Kindly please grace me.” Parikshit Maharaj was hearing and Sukadeva Goswami was speaking for seven days. All rishis, munis were there. And after seven days, all the knowledge was imparted to Parikshit Maharaj through the sound. A powerful person (Sukadeva). God enters (into Sukadeva). All the transcendental glories of name, form, attributes etc., he was speaking, and Parikshit Maharaj was attentively hearing, with total attention. By hearing seven days all the knowledge entered into him.

For example, there is a vessel full of water. If you have to take out water from the vessel, then you are to fill up the vessel with bricks and then there will not be a drop of water. Our attachment to the world, this body is not eternal, the sense organs are non-eternal. Whatever we have taken in cycles of births, we have taken non-eternal ideas. They are within us. When heavy things enter, light ideas will be purged out. Where is the person to speak, where is the person to hear? We have this example in the Bhagavat. We have to get an ideal person who has dedicated his life totaly for the service of Krishna, such a person can speak, where the knowledge or the transcendental qualities of the Supreme Lord have descended. For that, we pray for the grace of the preceptorial channel, pray for the grace of the devotees. By our own power we cannot speak. That will be something different.

Parikshit Maharaj was hearing and hearing, and after seven days he got the objective, ultimate goal. In Naimisharanya also, Shaunaka and sixty thousand other rishis heard for seven days. These are the examples in the scriptures. For that, we should not be disappointed. Something is better than nothing. But you have to try to do, try to engage your efforts so that you can hear—hear more and speak more. If you speak about worldly things, worldly things will enter you. You have to make it short, you should not speak unnecessarily, worldly things, 'grāmya-kathā nā śunibe, grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe.' All these rustic words you should avoid. Then your mind will go there. Try to avoid that. You engage your sense organs for the service of Krishna. Wherever you engage your sense organs that will remind you.

Now you are hearing. After that, you may clean the utensils and sing the glories. While cooking, for whom are you cooking? Cooking is also a great devotion. But here we keep a cook. Our Gurumaharaj did not want to keep a cook. He used to say, you have come to worship. Radharani Herself to cook food for Krishna. You have no desire to do this? You have got no love relation, that is the difficulty. If you engage the sense organs, subtle and gross, then you will be there. If you engage in non-eternal things you will be attracted to non-eternal things and all difficulties will automatically come. It is true for all. So we have imbibed thoughts in our mind through cycles of births. Those ideas are within us. If you say go away from my mind, by saying they will not go. If you keep a tenant in your house, after some time you say go away, if he has taken a position in your house, he will not go. No, I shall not go. We have accepted somebody, we have accepted all the ideas of the world with adoration. We have kept them in mind. If we say go now, they won't.

If you imbibe higher thoughts, transcendental thoughts of Krishna from a śuddha-bhakta, those will enter into you and all these rubbish ideas will be removed. Degree of devotional practice is necessary. How much degree you have got according to that you will get. Fruit is in the hand of Krishna. He is not interfering into the relative independence of living beings because if He interferes then consciousness will be destroyed. He is advising, by residing in the heart. Do this, do not do this. He is advising by descending in this world, by sending His own persons, and by as scriptures. You should avoid all these things, you should do these things. You should act accordingly, as per His advice. This is called Bhakti. In that way, if you go on practicing, as much you do, so much you will get. There is no doubt in it. He is equal to all. There is no fear in this. We may not be able to adjust ourselves because we are not omniscient. We may pose to be omniscient. I do not know what others did in their past. The Supreme Lord knows everything.

In Gita He said, 'karmaṇy ādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana.' You have got relative independence. Do karma, bad and good action. But the fruit is in My hand. In that way, I am controlling. You will not get fruit according to your desire. For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. In the vedas it has been said, 'mā hiṁsāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni'—do not inflict injury to any sentient being in the world. If you do it, it will have a reaction. But if your mind, body, everything is dedicated for the service of Krishna then if you serve, now you are taking food, all vegetables etc. life is there (in vegetables) also. But as per the direction of scriptures, as per direction of the Supreme Lord, you are taking prasād, those lives, those vegetables are benefited and by taking prasād all your sins will be destroyed. By only Harinam you cannot get. Harinam and Harikatha are medicines. But simultaneously you have to take prasad. If the diet is wrong, by taking medicine you cannot recover from the disease. Now there is naturopathy, without medicine. You have to take prasād. That which cannot be offered to the Supreme Lord, you should not take. After offering you have to take prasād.

He is inside you. One brahmana in this world, a point, nothing in this phenomena, this world is nothing. In that world one brahman of Pratishtanpura. He was a devotee of Narayana. Very poor. He used to offer bhoga to the Lord by mentally bringing all the things. One day he wanted to give (kheer) preparation of rice, sugar and milk and other spices etc. Very good. You have taken it in India, and also in Mayapur. Very good. He wanted to offer it to the Lord. He had no money. By mentally he bought everything. Good milk from a very good cow, fine rice—and mentally he prepared. After preparing it on the oven he thought I have to give it by 10AM otherwise Krishna will go to the forest. I am so much late. Immediately, he kept it down from the oven, and in a golden pot, he did not see any gold but mentally, he offered it to Narayan in a golden pot. And he thought, oh hot things should not be given. It is so much hot. I have committed a great offence. To feel heat he inserted his finger and his finger burnt, and he felt Oh, I have committed an offence. Narayana in Vaikuntha smiled. Lakshmi Devi said why you are smiling? So many planets, infinite brahmandas, in some world in some Earth in some place a very insignificant person is worshiping. Narayana knows everything. He is omniscient. (Narayan said to Lakshmi Devi,) “There is one devotee there; He is doing worship there. He is a great devotee. He wanted to give Me something. He has no money. So mentally he used to give. Today he offered kheer, a sweet made of milk. But he thought he offered it hot and he put his finger in it and it burnt. There is no actual kheer, mentally he offered, so I laughed. Do you want to see?”

He ordered Garuda to bring the person to Vaikuntha. Garuda went and brought him to Vaikuntha. He is Omniscient, Omnipresent. He knows everything. If you have belief in God, then you will get grace. If you have no belief, why will He grace you? For that reason, bonafide sādhu is neccessary. If there is want of a bonafide sādhu, then you have to go through the writings of the bonafide sadhu at least, writings that will have force because at the back of their writings Krishna is there. A śuddha-bhakta, then you will get some sort of impetus. You should not stop hearing and chanting. You should not stop.

articles.title: He is the Only Purush
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Guru Maharaj explains that Supreme Lord Sri Krishna is the only enjoyer, the pūrus and we are all prakṛti. We are to be dominated and enjoyed by Him. Those who have got a enjoying spirit, they act like a pūrus, they are averse to Sri Krishna, and they have forgotten the relation with Sri Krishna. Our every relation should be with Krishna only. If we do not want to serve Him with relation then we will get non eternal relations in this world and we will have to suffer threefold afflictions.

blocks.text: Our Guru Maharaj used to say that you should go through the biographies of pure devotees, then you will have inspiration how to worship Krishna. For conditioned souls of this world, always it is not good if you go on speaking about Krishna who has played the pastimes of an enjoyer and master. You may commit a mistake, thinking, 'Oh! Supreme Lord Sri Krishna has sixteen thousand one hundred eight (16108) wives, then we can also take two – three. When He can take as He is Supreme, we can also take two - three, what is the harm?'

He is the only enjoyer, He is the only pūrush and all others are not pūrush, we are all prakṛti. We are to be enjoyed and dominated by Him. When we take the ego of pūrush then everything will be lost. We are not pūrush, here male members are not pūrush, female members are not pūrush. Those who have got the enjoying spirit, they are acting like a pūrush, being averse to Sri Krishna, have forgotten the relation with Sri Krishna. They are enveloped by the illusory energy, they are thinking we are the enjoyer. Now we may be in female form or in male form, when the enjoying spirit is there that is called pūrush. We are not pūrush, pūrush is He (Lord Sri Krishna) and He is the only enjoyer in Vrindavan Dham. He is the only enjoyer and master and all are serving Him. They all have different love relations with Krishna—śānta, dāsya, sākhya, vātsalya and mādhurya. Whatever you see in this world, actually it exists in the transcendental realm of Vrindavan. This world is a perverted reflection. When we do not want to serve Krishna as eternal master then we shall get non-eternal master here and will have separation grief and we will be punished. When we do not want to serve Krishna as a friend, then we shall get a non-eternal friend here, that is the punishment. As much attachment we shall have as much separation grief you will have. When you do not want to serve Krishna as a son then you will get a non-eternal son here and when you do not want to serve Krishna as a husband then you will get a non-eternal husband, a perverted reflection of this transcendental realm. Every relation with Krishna.

articles.title: Do Not Spoil Even a Single Moment
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: In the initial part of this harikatha, Srila Gurudev sings the glories of Purushottam month and gives strong emphases on not spoiling even a single moment of this human birth without performing devotion to the Supreme Lord. Later, he elaborately narrated the pastimes of bewilderment of Brahma and explained how even Brahma, the creator of the universe, the topmost living being, got infatuated by the illusory energy of the Supreme Lord.

blocks.text: We are observing here the vow of Purushottam. You are not accustomed to it. After thirty-two months there is one additional month, it is called intercalary month. This month is inserted to harmonize the calendar with the solar calendar so that there cannot be any difficulty. About thirteen lunar months, actually twelve months every year, after thirty-two months one month is added. There are two groups in the Vedas. Our Gurumaharaj used to say, “Vedas have divided into two categories. One category is smārta. Smārta means karma-kāṇḍa. Another category is paramārtha or worship of the Supreme Lord without any desires of this world. Smārtas prescribe many kinds of ritualistic performance, functions etc. for twelve months and this additional month they think is unholy, “We shall not give any direction to do any good deeds. This additional month according to them is unholy, not sacred, inauspicious. But those who are spiritualists, at least those who have got love for worship of the Supreme Lord, say that we should not spoil a moment of our time. Why should we spoil this time, this month? If we think unholy things what will go with us? We will find in Gita Krishna has said,

Whatever you think at the time of death you will get your birth accordingly. If we think evil things in this world, we shall have to go to evil spirits. So what will you get? According to them you are not to spoil a moment. Human birth is precious. After creating human beings, the Supreme Lord got satisfied, why satisfied? He has created all the living beings.

There are eight-four lakh species. Aquatic animals are nine lakh, nine lakh is nine hundred thousand, two millions of plants, trees, etc. Jagadish Bose has scientifically proved that trees have got life. And after that eleven lakh births as worms, insects, etc. and ten lakh births as birds, thirty lakhs, i.e. three millions beasts and after that you get human birth; there are four-hundred thousand (four lakhs) human species. By creating, human body, God is satisfied, why? It is written in Srimad Bhagavatam, because they have got the discriminating power. Other living beings have no discriminating power. We have got the discriminating power of good and bad, eternal and non-eternal. They (humans) can give up non-eternal things and accept eternal truth. God is eternal truth. “Human beings are capable of worshiping Me”, God is saying. So after creating human birth He is satisfied. This human birth is meant only for worship of God, not for anything else. If you do activities like beasts and birds; eating, sleeping, defending and mating then you are not superior to beasts and birds. You have not got this human birth for that purpose.

If you do not worship God then you are equal to beasts and birds. We have become more ferocious than beasts, nowadays. Beasts, they also kill animals but for their livelihood, unnecessarily they do not kill. But human beings are killing unnecessarily and without any restriction women, children, whomever. They have no compassion for anybody. Tigers are ferocious, but they do not unnecessarily kill others. But we are doing this. So, this is a precious human birth, in this Purushottam masa, and according to Brihad Naradiya Purana this month is equal to Purushottama. Purushottam means Krishna. You will find in Gita
“I am beyond the comprehension of the conditioned souls of this world. I am supremely superior to impersonal formless Brahman and Paramātmā, partial manifestation. So I am designated as Purushottam.”

Purushottam is Krishna, Purushottam is Jagannath, Purusottama is Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. He is the Supreme Lord. We hold discourses on Srimad Bhagavatam, because it is the injunction, it is the direction of Valmiki Muni that you should go through Bhagavatam, daily. And in this Purushottam month, we are to think about Purushottama, we have to sing glories of Purushottama. Brahma submitted his prayers to Purushottama Krishna. At first he was infatuated by seeing Him. That you know. One thing I want to say to you, because I have heard, for that reason. Somewhere I have heard some people saying that as Brahma is our Guru, he cannot have infatuation. He cannot have bewilderment. He cannot be enchanted. How he did it here? Now you see, he played the pastimes of being infatuated is correct. But Vedavyasa Muni who has written Srimad Bhagavatam, he has not mentioned it, why? Very seriously you have to think. Because he wants that other human beings should get a lesson from this biography, from the infatuation of Brahma. Brahma, being the creator, but he could not understand the Supreme Lord. Vedavyasa Muni did not say he played the pastimes of infatuation. He did not say it. It will lessen the gravity of the subject. He knows everything, but he has not written. We have to take lessons from this, teachings from this. That is the purpose. Brahma is the creator of us, all the living beings of this world. He could not understand Krishna as Supreme Lord. He thought He is cowherd boy. And He is moving in the forest with other cowherd boys. He has got no opulences. He is tending the calves in the forest. He is poor. God would have totally of wealth, all the six fold opulences totality of wealth, totality of fame, totality of power, totality of beauty, totality of knowledge, totality of renunciation. Even God has got infinite opulence, not only six-fold opulences, He is infinite, and He has got infinite opulences. When you get the grace of Him, you can understand. I do not want to go into detail as you have heard it. Only I am remembering it.

Brahma lifted cowherd boys and calves from Vrindavan and kept them in the cave of the Sumeru Mountain for one year. When he saw Krishna kill Aghasura, a great demon, then he was astounded. How can a cowherd boy kill this demon, let me examine. He lifted the cowherd boys and calves and kept them for one year and after that when he came he saw the same Krishna moving in the forest with all the cowherd boys and calves, he was astounded. What is this? Is this magic? This cowherd boy is very cunning. Perhaps He came to learn that I have kept all of them in the cave of the Sumeru Mountain. He went back again to Sumeru Mountain, long distance, crores of miles. He went there. He saw them sleeping there. Same figure. What is this? Then again he came and saw they were moving. As he has got four heads, he was simultaneously seeing the same cowherd boys and calves there they are sleeping, here they are moving. Then he thought by my infatuation all human beings are infatuated, and I am infatuated, enchanted, then He must be my Master. He took absolute shelter. Then Krishna, what He did, immediately he (Brahma) saw, when actual submission will be there, he (Brahma) submitted from the core of the heart, taking shelter should be from the core of the heart, not outside show only. And Krishna immediately what He did, He showed all cowherd boys and calves as Vasudeva with śaṅkha cakra gadā padma dhari— four arms, conch shell, mace, lotus and disc. He (Brahma) understands Vasudeva, aiśvarya-mūrti majestic aspect. He understood, “Oh, You are my object of worship. I have committed a great offence by taking away cowherd boys when they were about to take food. I comitted a great offence.” Then he fell down and was praying to forgive him for the offences. Then again Krishna showed him His form where Krishna is standing, flute inserted inside his waist, cane and horn (vetra-viṣāṇa) under left hand armpit and in the left hand palm holding one morsel of yogurt and rice mixture. At first when he saw this he thought that Krishna did not know the Vedic instructions, that one should not eat food with the left hand, and He is using left hand.
But now, what he saw, by His grace, the same, and he saw all the Vasudeva mūrties are emanating from Krishna. Then he started submitting prayer,

Brahma-stava. Who is the ultimate reality. He (Brahma) said. Who could not understand and who thought he (Krishna) is a cowherd boy only. No opulence, nothing. But when Krishna graced him, Naumidya, you are Pujyatama, “You are the most venerable, You are Supreme Lord, prime Supreme Lord, cause of all causes, origin of all, there is no origin of You. All wealth, infinite wealth, You are the possessor of infinite wealth. And Your form is the sweetest, highest form (’bhra-vapuṣe). Your color is compared with rain born black cloud very charming, and Your cloth is yellow (taḍid-ambarāya) like lightning, dazzling, Your face is adorned with ornaments in the ear made of guñjā, a kind of small seed, red and black, all from the forest, and they have become the ornaments of Your ear, and in Your head dress, coronet, tail of the peacock, Your lotus face is dazzling with these.”

At first when he saw Him, he thought Him very poor. He has no silver ornaments, no golden ornaments, nothing, very poor. But now what he saw there is no comparison of it. He is attracted, “He is so beautiful.” Vanya-sraje—He has accepted garland not from various outside places with decoration, but from the wild flowers. Everything about Him is sweet. Brahma was attracted to Krishna. Krishna has worn that garland, vanamālā. Seeing morsel of rice and yogurt mixture in His left hand palm, before Brahma thought He did not know the sanction of the Vedas, and now he is seeing that there is no sweetness equal to this anywhere, not in Vaikuntha, the transcendental realm, Ayodhya, Dwaraka nowhere. He saw this by Krishna's grace. You are adorned with a bamboo flute, and in the left hand armpit cane and horn, and Your feet are so tender, so soft. We cannot tolerate, humans cannot tolerate, by that how You can move in this forest. He is the cause of all causes. When he surrendered he could know.

Like that you see, you remember the saying of Parampujyapad Shiksha Guru our Bhakti Vedanta Swami Maharaj. Remember it, very simple words. But in simple words, everything is there. 'When one is enlightened with knowledge by which ignorance is destroyed, then his knowledge reveals everything, as the sun lights up everything at day time.' Simple words. Here, this knowledge is not intellectual knowledge, it is self-effulgent knowledge. Bhagavan, Supreme Lord, is self-effulgent, the cause of all causes. He cannot be seen by our own endeavor, by inductive process, by process of ascension, by our own inherent capability. If He can be seen by that then He will lose His absolute position. Only by His grace you can see, He can descend to a completely surrendered soul. If you go in a challenging mood like Brahma, you will be deceived. You will not be able to understand. When one is enlightened with the self effulgent knowledge, by which his ignorance is destroyed then his knowledge reveals everything as the sun lights up everything. When the sun rises, through the rays of the sun you are seeing the sun and every other thing. There are varieties of creations. Sun is lighting up everything and you are seeing all aquatic animals, trees, etc, other animals, everything, lighting up everything. Through the rays of the sun, you are seeing the sun and simultaneously, he is showing others, everything in this universe. Like that, when the Supreme Lord - self-effulgent knowledge, self luminous descends then you will see your own self and all others, actual selves and actual relation. When you become puffed up with vanity, you do not care for the Supreme Lord, you do not submit to Him, illusory potency envelops you and you forget everything. You have got a misconception of self, false egos and false interests, you are fighting, the whole world is fighting. It is on the furnace. Actually all are related. In the night, if you want to see the sun can you see? Here in India, Kolkata, now it is night. In the night you cannot see the sun. If you collect all the lights of Kolkata, West Bengal, or India, can you see the sun? Sun cannot be seen by any other light. Sun has his own light, he is self luminous. You have to wait for the sun to rise and when the sun rises, you have to open your eyes, get the grace, light and through that you can see the sun and along with it other things also. Everything will be revealed. The sun is limited, but the Supreme Lord is unlimited. Supreme Lord is Absolute Knowledge; He is Absolute Existence; He is Absolute Bliss, when He will descend in your heart, then you will have Absolute Bliss, Absolute Knowledge, and you will see everything in its proper perspective and you cannot have any other activity, you cannot have any other different centers of interest. When we forget, we say we belong to India, we belong to Punjab, we belong to Pakistan, we belong to China, actually these are false egos. We have emanated from the Supreme Lord.

You are coming from Him, you are in Him, you are by Him. Geographically, so called religion barriers, so called national barriers and other group barriers, these are false. When you have the actual vision, you will have love for all. If you have love for Krishna, can I injure any of His parts? I have to love Him along with all His parts. You will love everybody. You cannot injure any of His parts. It is not possible. I cannot injure anybody, I have to love all His parts. Those who are doing heinous crimes, could they do it to their sons, wives, where they have got relations? They are not doing it. They are not seeing the relationship. We are all related. Through Supreme Lord Sri Krishna we are all related. We have a love relation. This knowledge you can get through devotion (bhakti). This is called paramārtha, not karma, through bhakti. That also our Swami Maharaj has said, very impressive words. You remember? This knowledge is the king of education, the most secret of all secrets. It is the purest knowledge and because it gives perception of the self by realization, it is the perfection of religion.

We are performing, observing penance, worship, everything, but without any practical experience; no experience is there. What benefit are we getting? Here, he says that it is the perfection of religion. It gives perception of self by realization. It is everlasting; it can be joyfully performed. What is the difficulty to utter the Holy Name? You will find in the prayers of Brahmaji to Krishna, we have now discussed this also

Here, Brahma is saying, addressing Krishna—one who sees Your grace in every circumstance, bad or good, tat te 'nukampāṁ su-samīkṣamāṇo—only by seeing, ordinary seeing, you will not be able to understand that it is actually for your own benefit, for your eternal benefit. Samīkṣamāṇo—means very carefully, minutely, another word 'Su', means nicely, very carefully if you see, then you can understand. Whatever you are getting difficulties, happiness, or suffering it is by the grace of the Supreme Lord. If you want to get the Supreme Lord then these are the conditions. Here, Krishna in the mouth of Brahma, Krishna is speaking from the mouth of Brahma, through Brahma. You should see the grace of the Supreme Lord everywhere, in your good time or bad time, you have to see whatever difficulties and miseries you have got, in that also you have to see His grace. So, first, you have to see His grace always, whatever He is doing, He is gracing, if you do not see His grace, you will not get it. Secondly, bhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam; whatever difficulties, miseries, and afflictions you are getting is due to your own karma, actions. We are reaping the fruits of our own actions. Nobody is to be blamed. But we cannot do this. If anybody behaves badly with me, we remember it for a long time. Then you cannot get God. If you want to get God, (then you have to see that) whatever difficulties you are getting now are due to your own actions, misdeeds. You are reaping the fruits of your own actions. They are only instrumental, they are not the cause. I might have done this, I might have behaved in such a way to some person some time in some birth. God knows everything. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent. He is restraining everyone. We have got relative independence, but we have got no hold over fruits.

We can do good and bad deeds, but we have got no hold over the fruits. Fruits are restrained by the Supreme Lord. When fruits are restrained by the Supreme Lord, then why do we blame others? Become free. If we become free, then we can freely, from the heart, call Krishna. We can engage the sense organs, everything for Krishna. If you always think these are persons who are hostile to me, they are doing such things, if you think like this, then how you will engage your energy for the worship of Krishna. Krishna is speaking through Brahma. We should see His grace in everything, He is everywhere. Without His grace nothing can be done. If anybody says anything can it be done without His approval, He will lose His absolute position. He is Absolute, Purna, Complete Reality. How can anyone do anything without His approval? He cannot. For that reason, bhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam, always think whatever vipāka, whatever difficulties, whatever miseries you are getting is due to our own karma. As Haridas Thakur, Prahlad Maharaj like that. Nobody is to be blamed, I am reaping fruits of my own karma, they are instrumental only. After that you engage your sense organs, mind, everything for the service of Krishna. Three - first you have to see the grace always and you have to know, you are reaping fruits of your own action and third you have to engage your sense organs, mind, intelligence, words everything for the service of Krishna, then you will get Him.

I wanted to say one thing. There are two paths, one is path for eternal welfare and another is for earthly pleasure, sensuous enjoyment. We say shreya and preya. You have to be accustomed with the terminology, śreya and preya. Śreya path, path which will give us eternal welfare. Preya path, it is pleasing, but consequence is not good. You find in Upanishad,

There are two paths; śreya, path for eternal welfare and preya, path for pleasure. You say hedonism. Hedonists say the chief aim of life is pleasure and this is called the path of earthly pleasures. One wise, steady person, he will consider these two and very carefully, he will deliberate, and understand that this path of śreya will take us to Supreme Bliss, it will be the cause of our emancipation, salvation and this preya path, at the beginning of enjoyment it may be like nectar, but its consequences will be poison. When you accept śreya, the path of eternal welfare, there you have to do penance, you have to restrict your sense organs, you have to perform penance, austerity etc. and at that time it seems like poison but the consequence will be ambrosia. But in the path of pleasure at first it will be like nectar, but its consequence will be poison. What will you take? A steady, wise person will accept śreya path if he wants actual benefit, actual eternal bliss. Śreya and preya both are resting in human beings. But you have to give up the path of pleasure and take the path of eternal welfare. Nowadays, if you want to take it to vote, you will not be able to win because ninety-nine percent are hedonists. They want pleasure, they will be in the brutal majority. You will be defeated. By vote you cannot get. A very few persons you will get. If you want quality, you cannot increase quantity. By vote you cannot get. One in a thousand, other nine hundred ninety-nine (999) persons will vote for hedonism, they will not vote for śreya path. You will be defeated brutally, you will lose your security deposit, everything. But we are not to follow them. You have to follow the saints, sadhus. If one good character person is here, in Kolkata, he can do immense good to lakhs of hundreds, thousands. If all are characterless, can they do any good to anybody? Whether number is required or quality is required? One qualified person, one sadhu, one actual sadhu can rescue the whole universe. But so many enslaved jivas are doing heinous crimes, how can they give good or bliss to the people? They themselves are burning, and they will burn others. For that reason you are not to see the number, you should see the quality. A qualified, bonafide sadhu, who is practically practicing, not only delivers speech. If he speaks only to deliver a speech then it will not be beneficial. You have to always remember all these teachings of Brahma, etc, Guruvarga, only to rectify yourself, not to rectify others, with that vanity you should not speak. We should speak all the defects, all the drawbacks you can mention, I am seeing my own drawbacks and to rectify me I shall speak. Those who have got these drawbacks they will also think about, Oh I also have this drawback and I should try to rectify myself. But you should not speak to rectify others, with that spirit, that will be vanity.
Hari-kirtan is for the satisfaction of Krishna, so that Krishna is satisfied.

In this way you have to do kirtan, then Krishna will be satisfied. We have already heard about Dhruva, a small boy, child. He accepted the teachings of his mother in toto, and he effaced all hostile mentalities from the heart, and started calling Narayana, 'kāhāṅ padma palāśa locan hari', 'kāhāṅ padma palāśa locan hari' in the forest. There Krishna comes and blessed him, as Narada. First he went to rescue his father Uttanapada. When Dhruva was crying, Dhruva did not go to his father, be kind to me, or to his step mother. But he was calling Krishna removing all the hostile mentalities from the heart, and all are satisfied, Krishna is satisfied. We have to do it like this.
